objective: Prevent premature cross-market inference and engine proliferation while preserving a clear path to category-rotation and capital-flow intelligence once empirical prerequisites exist.
entry_requirements: At least two categories with claim-sufficient rights-admitted market evidence
At least two geographies with comparable methodology and freshness windows
Independent source-owner requirements satisfied for compared signals
Entity, currency, condition and time-window normalization PASS
No category uses architecture coverage or proxy assumptions as empirical market truth
Backtest and temporal leakage controls PASS
Derived cross-market claims receive content-bound registered hardening proof
new_engine_policy: Reuse the owned graph/factor/engine mesh by default. A new standalone engine requires evidence that existing processors cannot express the validated cross-market function without semantic or reliability loss.
